title: Magnetic Cap Remover
description:
Magnetic Cap Remover
This magnetic cap remover is ideal for removing hot caps from your dynavap. Possibly one of the handiest little cap removers for those who can’t wait for the cap to cool down. or for those who want a very stylish ring.
Included
1 X Magnetic Cap Remover
